prior_specification_disposition: V1 froze the post-selected rule but had no durable delayed-arrival state in each score row. V1 is specification history only and contributes zero evaluation evidence. V2 begins only after delayed 50/100/250/500ms arrival books and boundary checks were deployed.
selection_disclosure: The 0-10 second boundary band was identified after inspecting public-flow-cost-confirmed-v2. All signals and outcomes before evidence_started_at are discovery only, including the 18-market 18/18 terminal result and every WAL latency replay.
hypothesis: A completed wrong-way public sweep that is absorbed and followed by one-tick executable improvement in the opposite token during the final ten seconds contains terminal resolver information beyond the executable ask and crypto taker fee.

frozen_mechanics.market_scope: crypto direction markets with an authoritative scheduled resolver boundary and terminal outcome
frozen_mechanics.entry_window: strictly 0 < seconds_to_resolution <= 10 at the existing confirmation time
frozen_mechanics.independence: first qualifying signal per condition_id only; never stack one market
frozen_mechanics.arrival_rule: use only the last causal CLOB book at or before confirmation plus order transit; reject stale, crossed, missing-capacity, connection-gap, post-boundary or non-marketable arrivals
frozen_mechanics.fill: FOK-style paper fill at arrival ask, min($10/ask, 20% displayed arrival ask size), minimum $1 notional
frozen_mechanics.exit: hold to official terminal resolution; no post-boundary book exit is credited
frozen_mechanics.costs: exact entry taker fee; primary inference requires doubled entry-fee stress positive
frozen_mechanics.persisted_evidence: pm_flow_scores.markouts.order_latency stores each delayed causal touch, age, boundary, displayed capacity, fill decision, fee and rejection reason before hot-touch pruning
frozen_mechanics.post_selected_parameter: The 10-second band was selected after the discovery autopsy and cannot use any pre-freeze row as evidence.
frozen_mechanics.mechanism_argument: Inside ten seconds, a completed wrong-way sweep followed by opposite-book improvement can reveal which side has absorbed stale boundary flow; outside that band the same Flow arm was negative. This is a testable resolver-state mechanism, not a claim that the historical cutoff is optimal.
frozen_mechanics.parameter_note: The 10-second band is explicitly post-selection and therefore PROVISIONAL; it is frozen here rather than claimed as validated. The 250ms primary transit is a conservative execution specification, not the historically best-PnL cell.

minimum_read.multiple_testing_correction: Holm correction across every Flow arm, information latency, order latency, horizon and inspected TTE bucket
minimum_read.capacity_metric: realized dollars per independent market at displayed 20%-touch capacity

failure_conditions: Either chronological half is non-positive at doubled entry fees
The market- or day-clustered 95% lower bound is not above zero
The 250ms arrival cohort is negative or fewer than 90% of decisions have a persisted causal arrival book
Profit depends on orders arriving at or after the resolver boundary
Live authenticated acknowledgement/fill slippage consumes the paper lower bound
zero_edge_disclosure: The discovery result may be selection noise or a paper-fill artifact. A zero or negative forward result is an expected and valid outcome.
